description: This file defines the PdfInternals class within the PdfSharp library, providing internal access and manipulation of PDF document data structures, including document IDs, object retrieval and management, and internal references.

classes.name: PdfInternals
classes.description: Provides internal access to PDF document data structures such as document IDs, objects, and cross-references within the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: GuidFromString
methods.description: Converts a string of length 16 to a GUID by interpreting each character as a byte value.

methods.name: CreateIndirectObject
methods.description: Creates a new indirect PDF object of a specified type, adds it to the document, and returns it.

methods.name: AddObject
methods.description: Adds a PdfObject as an indirect object to the document's internal reference table.

methods.name: RemoveObject
methods.description: Removes a PdfObject from the document's internal reference table.

methods.name: GetClosure
methods.description: Returns all objects reachable from a given PdfObject, including the object itself, via indirect references.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes a PdfItem into a stream, used internally by the PDF writer.
